title: SmartPLS & SEM Introduction
tagline: Structural equation modeling, measurement validation, bootstrapping, and mediation analysis.
outcomes: Determine when Partial Least Squares SEM is superior to Covariance-Based SEM (CB-SEM).
Evaluate reflective measurement models using indicator reliability, AVE, CR, and the HTMT criterion.
Assess structural models using bootstrapping (5,000 samples), path coefficients, R-squared, and f-squared.
Test mediation and moderation hypotheses and draft complete Chapter 4 reporting tables.
